maintenance_items.description: Benelli TRK 502 uses a timing chain, not a belt.
First change at 1,000 km (break-in). Then every 6,000 km (7k, 13k, 19k, 25k...). Use 10W-50 semi-synthetic.
Replace every 6,000 km starting at 7,000 km. Replace more frequently in dusty or humid conditions.
Inspect at 7,000 and 13,000 km. Replace at 19,000 and 25,000 km.
Replace completely every 2 years. Includes clutch hydraulic fluid.
Replace every 2 years or 13,000 km, whichever comes first.

maintenance_items.label: Chain clean, lube & tension
maintenance_items.description: Clean, lubricate and adjust chain tension every 500 km, after washing, or after riding in rain.

maintenance_items.label: Drive kit (chain & sprockets)
maintenance_items.description: Replace chain, front sprocket and rear crown as a set every 21,000-22,000 km.

maintenance_items.label: Valve clearance adjustment
maintenance_items.description: Inspect and adjust valve clearance every 22,000 km.

maintenance_items.label: Fuel filter
maintenance_items.description: Inspect at intermediate services, replace at 19,000 km.

maintenance_items.label: Fuel hoses
maintenance_items.description: Replace every 3 years to prevent cracking and fuel leaks.

maintenance_items.label: Brake hoses
maintenance_items.description: Replace hydraulic brake hoses every 4 years.

maintenance_items.label: Brake pump & caliper service
maintenance_items.description: Replace internal parts of brake pumps and calipers every 2 years.

maintenance_items.label: Fork oil
maintenance_items.description: Change front fork oil at 13,000 km and again at 19,000 km.

maintenance_items.label: Steering bearings
maintenance_items.description: Check play, adjust, and lubricate with lithium grease every 19,000 km.

maintenance_items.label: Wheel bearings
maintenance_items.description: Inspect visually and replace every 40,000 km.
